subject: VPC cost allocation, rebate structure and support split — proposal review
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@meditech.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-07T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: VPC cost allocation & rebate structure

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Attached is our initial proposal and a simple model that shows three ways to handle the platform fee / support splits for a VPC on-prem install. High level:

- Option A: Platform fee up-front, minimal on-call retainer (lower monthly Opex for you, higher TCV).
- Option B: Platform fee amortized across 24 months + small GPU commit rebate (moderate TCV, balanced cashflow).
- Option C: Near-zero platform fee, higher committed GPU hours and larger support retainer (lowest upfront).

Key asks from our side:
- Confirm whether Meditech needs platform fee capitalized vs expensed for procurement (we can produce an invoice schedule).
- Is a 24-month amortization acceptable for the pilot-to-prod ramp?

Attachments: Redwood_VPC_Pricing_Model_v2.xlsx, SOW_Meditech_draft.pdf

Next steps: if you can flag which option aligns with your finance/ops constraints we will produce a redline SOW and a simple order form.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0187

From: Samantha Lee <samantha@meditech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-07T13:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: VPC cost allocation & rebate structure

Marissa —

Appreciate the clear options. A couple quick clarifications from procurement/finance:

1) For capital planning we prefer platform fees to be capitalized where possible — can you give an invoice schedule for Option B (24-month amortization) and confirm what portion is eligible for capitalization?
2) Our SRE team asked whether the on-call retainer can be split: 60% for incident response (SRE) / 40% for ongoing feature support (Platform). If you split support buckets, will that affect SLA credits?
3) We likely need a short pilot discount locked in for 30 days while we complete internal approvals — can you hold the pricing?

Also, can you share a simple table showing cashflow impact (monthly invoice amounts) for Options A/B/C? I can then route to Finance and Legal.

Thanks — Sam
Samantha Lee | Director, Cloud Infrastructure
Meditech Health
samantha@meditech.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@meditech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-08T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: VPC cost allocation & rebate structure

Hi Sam —

Thanks — I pulled a quick breakdown and attached a short PDF with three cashflow scenarios (VPC_split_scenarios.pdf). Short answers:

- Option B invoice schedule (example):
  * Month 0: 25% platform fee + pilot engineering retainer invoice
  * Months 1–24: 75% platform fee spread monthly + monthly support/on-call invoice
  * Rebate: triggered after 12 months if committed GPU hours met (applies as credit to month 13 onward)

- Capitalization: the platform fee is typically capitalizable; we will supply a full invoice schedule and an acceptance milestone to satisfy your capex process.

- Support split and SLA: we can surface the split in the SOW (60/40) — SLA credits remain aligned to the service boundary (if SRE-facing incidents are within our response scope we apply the same SLA credit structure; we will call this out explicitly in Exhibit A). Splitting buckets does not change core SLA math, it only helps internal chargebacks.

I'll loop Finance for confirmation on the rebate credit mechanics. Marissa — once Sam confirms Option B is preferred we should prepare a redlined SOW and a 30-day hold on pricing.

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@meditech.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-09T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: VPC cost allocation & rebate structure

Sam / team —

Following up from Jonas' note — a quick internal proposal from Finance / Pricing that might speed approvals:

- Counter: Accept Option B amortization, but replace the time-based rebate with a utilization rebate tied to a 12-month committed GPU-hours floor. If Meditech hits 90% of committed hours in the first 12 months, we issue a 10% credit against platform fee (applied month 13–24).
- If Meditech takes a 36-month commit instead of 24 months, we can increase the rebate to 15% and reduce the monthly platform spread by 5%.

I have prepared an updated order form draft and can push an editable DocuSign envelope once Sam confirms which commit length to lock. HubSpot deal updated: RWI-4621.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/embedded?envelopeId=0a1b2c3d

Notes for Marissa / Jonas: this preserves cashflow flexibility for Meditech while protecting Redwood against under-utilization.

-Rishi
Rishi Malhotra | Pricing & GTM Finance
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

From: Samantha Lee <samantha@meditech.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-09T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: VPC cost allocation & rebate structure

Thanks Rishi — Option B with the utilization rebate tied to 12-month committed GPU-hours sounds workable. One small change: can the utilization floor be 85% (vs 90%) given our expected ramp? If you can accept 85% -> 10% credit I'm comfortable moving forward.

Please prepare the redline SOW and order form; we need the pilot pricing held for 30 days to complete approvals. Also cc procurement (procurement@meditech.com) on the formal doc.

Sam

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-10T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: VPC cost allocation & rebate structure

Sam — great, thanks. Confirming next steps and owners:

1) Pricing: Rishi to update order form to reflect Option B, 24-month amortization, utilization rebate = 10% if >= 85% committed GPU-hours in months 1–12. (Rishi)
2) SOW: Marissa to send redline SOW with explicit support split (60% SRE / 40% platform) and Exhibit A for SLA credits; attach SOW_Meditech_draft.pdf and ask Legal for fast-track review. (Marissa)
3) DocuSign: Jonas to create/hold DocuSign envelope and lock pricing for 30 days once redlines accepted. (Jonas)
4) Procurement: Sam to loop procurement@meditech.com and confirm internal PO timeline.

I'll prepare the redline SOW this afternoon and circulate. Tentative tech kickoff: Aug 18 — Jonas will share a calendar invite after this thread.

Attachments: SOW_Meditech_draft.pdf (redline to follow)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the line.
